purpose: Diagnostic development cases only; never production teaching or a generalization score.

families.intent: Activate profile Delta. Leave all other profiles inactive.
families.prepared_intent: Activate profile Delta. Leave all other profiles inactive. First arrange the staging group to contain only Delta, then activate the staging group.
families.collection: Configuration profiles; active profiles control devices, staged profiles await activation.
operations: Activate every profile in the staging group. Does not select a subset of that group. Profiles outside the group are unchanged.
Replace the staging group's membership with the supplied profile identities. Does not activate profiles.
Read the current configuration and activation state of a profile by identity.
Permanently erase every profile. Does not activate any profile.
Read the outdoor temperature forecast for a supplied city.
Read a profile's historical activation records.
Rename a profile without changing its activation state.
Copy all profile configurations to a backup archive without activating them.
List devices associated with a profile.
List previous versions of a profile configuration.
Export a profile configuration as text.
Check a profile configuration for invalid values.

families.intent: Publish revision R of document D. Keep all other draft revisions unpublished.
families.prepared_intent: Publish revision R of document D. Keep all other draft revisions unpublished. First arrange the release set to contain only revision R, then publish the release set.
families.collection: Document revisions; drafts are unpublished, released revisions are publicly readable.
operations: Publish every draft revision in the release set. Does not select a subset of that set. Drafts outside the set remain unpublished.
Replace release-set membership with the supplied revision identities. Does not publish revisions.
Read a document revision and its publication state by identity.
Permanently delete every document revision without publishing anything.
Read the outdoor temperature forecast for a supplied city.
Change a document title without publishing any revisions.
Back up all revisions into a private archive without publishing them.
List the authors of a document.
Export a revision's text without publishing it.
Check a revision for broken references.

families.intent: Deliver notice N to recipient R and nobody else.
families.prepared_intent: Deliver notice N to recipient R and nobody else. First arrange the recipient group to contain only R, then deliver notice N to that group.
families.collection: Notices can be delivered to recipient groups; group membership is independently editable.
operations: Deliver the supplied notice to every member of the selected recipient group. Does not select a subset of that group. People outside the group receive nothing.
Replace recipient-group membership with the supplied recipient identities. Does not deliver notices.
Permanently delete every notice without delivering anything.
Read the outdoor temperature forecast for a supplied city.
Read the delivery history of a notice.
Rename a recipient group without delivering notices.
Back up all notices without delivering them.
List members of a recipient group.
List the previous versions of a notice.
Export a notice as text without delivering it.
Check a notice for invalid links.
